displayname: The Cat in the Hat - Dr. Seuss
description: in a cold and wet day, two children are visited by a mischievous cat, wearing a tall, red and white-striped hat. To entertain the children, the Cat performs wacky tricks, creating a mess of the house. Will mother find out about the Cat and see the mess? \"I know some good games we could play,\" Said the cat \"I know some new tricks,\" Said the Cat in the Hat. New features only available in this omBook include professional narration, background audio and enlarged artwork for each scene.
